full_prompt_en: A square minimalist graphic illustration shows two dark-suited figures standing back to back beneath one black umbrella, surrounded by a broad, flat teal-blue field. The upper half is mostly unmarked blue negative space, giving the small central group a deliberate sense of isolation. Near the top center, the umbrella forms a clean, low black arc with a thin upright handle descending between the figures. On the left, a figure faces away in profile, head lowered slightly; a compact black case hangs from one hand beside the leg. On the right, a second figure faces the opposite direction, with a pale blue face and a narrow bright strip of shirt showing between dark jacket panels. Both are built largely from solid black shapes, with only a few blue cuts defining heads, arms, and the space between them. Across the lower third, a thin white horizontal line passes through the scene, marking the division above a reflective water surface. Below it, the paired dark forms stretch downward as broken black ripples, interrupted by short white strokes and narrow blue gaps. The reflection is not a smooth mirror image: its wavering stripes give the flat design a small area of motion and texture. The top of the water remains nearly level, while the lower edge becomes a sequence of increasingly loose black marks. Lighting is graphic rather than naturalistic, with the lightest values reserved for the white line, pale face, and scattered glints; no modeled cast shadow appears on the blue ground. The palette is held almost entirely to medium teal-blue, black, and small white accents. The overall composition turns two opposing silhouettes and their shared overhead shape into a quiet visual riddle, using immense negative space and a narrow band of reflection for rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形极简图形插画描绘两名穿深色西装的人物背对背站在一把黑伞下，周围是宽阔、平坦的蓝绿色面。上半部大多是未经描绘的蓝色留白，使中央的小组形体显得刻意孤立。画面上方中央附近，伞面形成干净、低矮的黑色弧线，细直伞柄从两人之间向下延伸。左侧一人侧身背向另一人，头微微垂下；一只紧凑的黑色提包挂在腿旁的一只手上。右侧第二人朝相反方向，脸为浅蓝色，深色外套之间露出窄条明亮衬衫。两人主要由实心黑色形状构成，只用少量蓝色切口区分头部、手臂及其间空隙。画面下三分之一处，一条细白色横线穿过场景，标出反光水面上方的分界。横线以下，两道深色形体伸展为断裂的黑色水纹，其中穿插短白笔画和细窄蓝色空隙。倒影并非平滑镜像；颤动的条纹为平面设计加入一小片动态与肌理。水面的上边界基本平直，靠近下画边则变成越来越松散的黑色痕迹。光线以图形方式而非自然主义方式呈现，最亮的明度留给白线、浅色脸部和零散反光；蓝色地面没有经塑形的投影。配色几乎全部限制在中等蓝绿色、黑色和少量白色强调之间。整体构图把相反方向的两道剪影及其共用的上方形体变成安静的视觉谜题，以广阔留白和狭窄倒影带形成节奏。
style_prompt_en: The graphic illustration relies on large uninterrupted color fields, dense black silhouettes, and a few sharp white cuts. Teal-blue carries most of the image area, so even narrow pale accents read strongly. Shapes are reduced to decisive flat contours; internal detail is sparse, and adjacent dark masses remain legible through carefully placed gaps. A long horizontal division anchors the lower region, where repeated broken strokes introduce a rougher, rhythmic texture against the otherwise smooth fields. Illumination is expressed through value placement rather than gradual shading, and the contrast remains bold even at small scale. Broad empty space surrounds a compact cluster of interlocking forms, giving the image stillness while the short fragmented marks add controlled movement. The overall finish is crisp, economical, and slightly enigmatic.
style_prompt_zh: 图形插画依靠大片连续色域、浓重黑色剪影和少数尖锐白色切口。蓝绿色占据画面绝大部分面积，因此即使很窄的浅色强调也十分醒目。形状被简化为果断的平面轮廓；内部细节稀少，相邻深色块靠精心安排的空隙维持可辨性。一条长横向分界锚定下部区域，那里重复的断裂笔画为其他平滑色域加入较粗糙的节奏肌理。照明通过明度分配而非渐层阴影表达，缩小时反差仍然有力。宽阔留白围住紧凑交织的形体，使图像安静，短小破碎痕迹则加入受控的运动感。整体完成面利落、节制，略带谜样气氛。
theme_en: Two dark suited figures beneath an umbrella reflected in blue water
theme_zh: 两名深色西装人物共处伞下，倒影落在蓝色水面
name: David Aja
